lemmas.name: reciprocal_closure_identity
lemmas.statement: For admitted nonzero g with typed inverse h and local unit e, g*h == e.

lemmas.name: gfe_polynomial_residual_normalized
lemmas.statement: Under e == 1, rho == g + g^-1 - 2 implies rho*g == (g-1)^2.

lemmas.name: log_reciprocal_cancellation
lemmas.statement: On one admitted branch, Log_H(g^-1) == Cancel(Log_H(g)).

lemmas.name: state_ideal_quotient_field
lemmas.statement: For nonzero rational alpha, Q[g,h,rho]/<g-alpha,h-alpha^-1,rho-(alpha+alpha^-1-2)> is isomorphic to Q.

lemmas.name: looking_glass_trace_closure
lemmas.statement: Reversing the recorded proof path from a conclusion reaches the same canonical premise root.

lemmas.name: ouroboros_repeat_termination
lemmas.statement: Revisiting a canonical optimization state closes the bounded cycle deterministically.

lemmas.name: single_shard_exact_recovery
lemmas.statement: For four data shards and XOR parity, any one unavailable shard is reconstructed exactly from the other four.

lemmas.name: monotonic_conflict_admission
lemmas.statement: The Pass 143 selector commits only a candidate whose exact weighted conflict energy does not exceed the current state's energy.

lemmas.name: global_entropy_neutrality_by_reconstruction
lemmas.statement: If transformed state plus receipt reconstructs canonical input exactly, unrecoverable canonical information loss is zero under the HHS definition.

lemmas.name: parent_tree_immutability
lemmas.statement: All inherited Pass 143 files retain their recorded byte sizes and SHA-256 identities in Pass 144.
